claim_ledger.claim_text: Owned governed agentic AI platform architecture as the foundation for repeatable enterprise deployment.
Connected platform productization and IP-led commercialization with enterprise adoption and reusable services.
Integrated partner-supported adoption into the commercial operating model for enterprise AI.

companion_unify_bullets_context.text:
- bul_unify_001: Architected a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows, combining L0 route-policy dispatch, multi-agent orchestration contracts, and human override escalation paths.
- bul_unify_002: Drove CFO-aligned enterprise adoption motions tied to reusable AI platform commercialization through partner-supported deal cycles and usage-based subscription forecasting.
- bul_unify_003: Established audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows by instrumenting evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls across production agent execution.
- bul_unify_004: Standardized the AI systems lifecycle end to end, compressing the lab-to-production cycle from six months to three weeks through managed workflow orchestration.
- bul_unify_005: Engineered high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms, integrating Databricks Lakehouse pipelines with dense sparse exact retrieval design.
- bul_unify_006: Scaled the platform engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability under a disciplined operating model for agentic AI.
